dossier.headline: Nvidia's first results without Jensen Huang
dossier.summary: Nvidia reports third-quarter results on 17 November after the US close, its first report since Jensen Huang stepped down as CEO, with CFO Colette Kress presenting as interim CEO. The stock is more than 30% below its October peak, and third-quarter sales are expected around $109 billion.
why_it_matters: The results are a key read for AI and chip stocks worldwide
They land before India's Wednesday open, so Indian IT and chip-linked names take the read-through
watch: Sales against the roughly $109 billion expectation
Guidance and commentary under the interim CEO
questions: Can the results steady the stock after the leadership shock?
How much does the AI trade hinge on one report?
